# Run chatty tests. Assert on CONT lines.
go test chatty_test.go -v

# This fork starts every test in parallel, so the three subtests interleave and
# finish in any order. Pinning that order would pin a race. What the framing
# must still do is announce each subtest before its output resumes, and print
# every log line exactly once.
stdout '=== (CONT|NAME)  TestChatty/sub-0'
stdout '=== (CONT|NAME)  TestChatty/sub-1'
stdout '=== (CONT|NAME)  TestChatty/sub-2'
stdout -count=2 'this is sub-0'
stdout -count=2 'this is sub-1'
stdout -count=2 'this is sub-2'
stdout '--- PASS: TestChatty'

-- chatty_test.go --
package chatty_test

import (
	"testing"
	"fmt"
)

func TestChatty(t *testing.T) {
    for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
        t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("sub-%d", i), func(t *testing.T) {
            for j := 0; j < 2; j++ {
                t.Logf("this is sub-%d", i)
            }
        })
    }
}
